resolutions.researcher_notes: [carried from v2 deepsweep-20260902@2026-09-02] Checked a cross-shard lead (Gao'an-named rows P5861/P4778 filed a reciprocal WEP2-vs-Phase-I misattribution __REDUNDANCY__) against this row. Fetched the 2013 Jiangxi provincial gas plan PDF cited in that lead (pdftotext -layout, not url_verifier's extractor, which misses this CJK PDF's text layer) and independently confirmed two dated facts in it: (1) 川气东送 (Sichuan-East Gas Transmission) began supplying Jiangxi gas 2010-06, feeding the province's 'Phase I' 870km network (6 named trunks: 九江-南昌/九江-沙河/九江-景德镇/南昌-丰城/高安-新余/丰城-抚州 + 田南-上高支线); (2) 西气东输二线 (WEP2) did not begin supplying Jiangxi gas until 2011-09, feeding a separate 98km 'Phase II' network (吉安/赣州/安义 sections + 宜春/萍乡). P4793's own StartYear1=2010-12 predates WEP2's actual first gas delivery to Jiangxi by ~9 months, and instead lines up with the Sichuan-East/Phase-I supply-start window (2010-06), while the row's FuelSource is staged as 'West-East Gas Pipeline' and its wiki section header names it 西气东输二线高余线 (explicitly a WEP2 branch codename) — the two signals conflict. Neither '高安-余江' nor '高余线' appears among the plan document's named Phase I trunks, so I cannot independently confirm this is a Phase I line either (the document's trunk list is prefaced '主要建成' — 'mainly built', i.e. not necessarily exhaustive). The document also states Yingtan (this row's own end city) had NO long-distance pipeline gas as of end-2012, which is at minimum consistent with a phased build (matches this row's own StartYear2=2011/StartYear3=2013 spread) and does not rule out either gas-source story. Net: a genuine, evidence-based tension between the row's StartYear1 and its WEP2/Sichuan-East attribution, of the same shape as the sibling P5861/P4778 finding but NOT as clean-cut (their case had a verbatim trunk-name match in the Phase I list; this row does not). Flagging for human adjudication on FuelSource/parent-network attribution — NOT recommending any value change or row action.
